QuestInfo.name: [Magatia] Ericsson's Ingredients
QuestInfo.1: Surprisingly, #p2012018# appears to be #p2111004#'s younger brother. Amazing! #p2012018#, with a serious look on his face, offered to help his sister as much as he can. He has asked you to find #b100 #t4000060#s#k to make her medicine with.\n#i4000060##t4000060# #b#c4000060##k/100
QuestInfo.2: When I gathered up all the ingredients for #p2012018#, he asked me to wait for a bit.

0.0: 휴우. 필리아가 오르비스를 떠난지 벌써 몇 년인지 모르겠군. 그 망할 연금술사 때문에 마가티아에까지 가 있다니... 게다가 딸까지 낳았을 줄은 정말 몰랐어. 조카가 생긴 것도 모르고 있었다니... 응? 필리아와 무슨 관계냐고? 필리아는 누나야.
0.1: 필리아의 부탁이라면 물론 들어 줘야지. 약은 만들어 주겠어. 하지만 키니라는 아이의 상세가 편지에 쓰여 있는대로라면, 약을 만드는 게 쉽지는 않겠는걸... 괜찮다면, 네가 좀 도와주지 않겠어?

yes.0: 음... 키니를 위한 약을 만들려면... 이거 어렵군... 음... 그러니까, 루나픽시의 달조각과 50개와 페어리의 더듬이 10개를 구해와 줘. 그걸로 일단 약을 만들어 볼게.

no.0: 도와줄 수 없다니, 이제와서 치사하잖아. 다시 한 번 생각해 보라고.

0.0: Hmm... I can't even remember the exact number of years it has been since #p2111004# left #b#m200000000##k. I can't believe she's all the way out to #m261000000# because of that stupid alchemist. I didn't even know that she had a daughter. I didn't think I'd ever have a niece, you know! What's my relationship with #p2111004#? #p2111004# is my sister.
0.1: Of course, if it's a favor for #p2111004#, I'll do it. It's just that... if #p2111005#'s condition is really as bad as it says in the letter, then it won't be easy for me to make medicine that potent... I'll need your help.

yes.0: Hmm... Medicine for #p2111005#... This won't be easy...um...so, I'll need #b100 #t4000060#s#k, which I can use to make the medicine.

no.0: You can't help now? That's not right. You can't pull back now. Think again.

1.0: Hmm... Did you bring all the ingredients? While you were busy gathering them up, I did some preparation work so everything's set now. I'll make the medicine now, but it's going to take a while. It's not an easy one to make, so wait for a bit.

item.0: You haven't gotten them all yet! I need #b100 #t4000060#s#k. Don't forget!
